params.name: timestamp
params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) for the historical snapshot. Must be after 2016-05-11T00:00:00Z (Unix timestamp 1462924800).

params.name: bounds
params.description: Geographic bounding box in the format "north,south,west,east" (e.g., "51.5,51.0,-0.5,0.5"). Latitudes range -90 to 90; longitudes -180 to 180. North must be greater than south.

params.name: flights
params.description: Comma-separated list of flight numbers (e.g., "BA123,LH456"). Maximum 15 values.

params.name: callsigns
params.description: Comma-separated list of ATC callsigns (e.g., "BAW123,DLH456"). Maximum 15 values.

params.name: registrations
params.description: Comma-separated list of aircraft registration codes (e.g., "G-STBK,D-ABCD"). Maximum 15 values.

params.name: painted_as
params.description: Comma-separated list of airline ICAO codes for the livery carrier (e.g., "BAW,DLH"). Maximum 15 values.

params.name: operating_as
params.description: Comma-separated list of airline ICAO codes for the operating carrier. Maximum 15 values.

params.name: airports
params.description: Comma-separated list of airport IATA or ICAO codes. Matches flights departing or arriving at these airports. Maximum 15 values.

params.name: routes
params.description: Comma-separated list of routes in origin-destination format (e.g., "LHR-JFK"). Maximum 15 values.

params.name: aircraft
params.description: ICAO aircraft type code (e.g., "B77W", "A320").

params.name: altitude_ranges
params.description: Comma-separated altitude ranges in feet using "min-max" format (e.g., "0-5000,35000-45000"). Minimum altitude is -2000 ft. Maximum 15 ranges.

params.name: squawks
params.description: Comma-separated list of transponder squawk codes (4-digit octal, e.g., "7700,7600"). Maximum 15 values.

params.name: categories
params.description: Comma-separated list of aircraft/vehicle category codes. Maximum 15 values. P=Passenger, C=Cargo, M=Military and Government, J=Business Jets, T=General Aviation, H=Helicopters, B=Lighter than Air, G=Gliders, D=Drones, V=Ground Vehicles, O=Other, N=Non-Categorized.

params.name: data_sources
params.description: Comma-separated list of data source types (e.g., "ADSB,MLAT"). Maximum 15 values.

params.name: gspeed
params.description: Ground speed filter in knots (0-5000), or a range string (e.g., "200-400").

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-30000).

items.docs: Provides historical aircraft positional data using Unix timestamp. Returns lightweight position records (latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, heading, callsign, registration) for past flights. Historical data coverage extends back to May 11, 2016, with availability depending on the subscription plan. A timestamp and at least one additional filter parameter are required.

items.docs: Returns full historical aircraft flight movement records for a given time window, combining positional data with enriched flight metadata including origin, destination, callsign, registration, aircraft type, and operator.
